meta.title: Logistic Regression - Tuning Workflow
meta.subtitle: Prepare data (shared) to per-fold CV to logged CV F1_UP; stops at tuning history

lanes.label: Prepare Data (shared - identical for all 3 models)

cards.title: What is different vs RF / GB
items: Algorithm: linear model (StandardScaler + LogisticRegression), not trees
Params: C=6.59e-05 (very strong L2 regularization), solver=liblinear
Class imbalance handled by class_weight=balanced inside the estimator

cards.title: CV on TRAIN (how the F1 is produced)
items: TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=5, gap=5) on TRAIN only, no shuffle
Each fold: fit on train-part, tune threshold on train-part, score val-part
Reported number is the mean UP-class F1 over the 5 folds: 0.5490

cards.title: Where this diagram stops
items: Ends when the CV F1_UP is appended to experiments/tuning_history.csv
Fingerprint f6cb3ac8f820 (20 features) ties the run to this dataset version
Final fit, TEST evaluation and model selection are NOT part of this view
